name: Morphological Noise Filter
description: Performs morphological operations (Opening / Closing) to remove isolated obstacle noise and fill small holes on the map, outputting a sparse overlay mask.

inputs.label: ROI Region (Optional)
inputs.description: Select rectangular region to apply noise filter. If omitted or not drawn, entire map will be processed.

properties.name: mode
properties.label: Filter Mode
properties.description: Select morphological operation: remove isolated obstacles (Opening), fill small holes (Closing), or both.

properties.name: noise_size
properties.label: Noise Size (m)
properties.description: Target noise diameter in meters (automatically converted to grid cell radius).

properties.name: kernel_shape
properties.label: Kernel Shape
properties.description: Structuring element shape for morphology operations.
